preservedResponsibilities: Body section output uses native page descriptors and page frames. The initial section uses the first block assignments, subsequent assignments close the preceding paragraph or use a structural paragraph after a table, and the final section is owned by the document body. Page size, physical margins, page parity, writing direction and the optional decimal restart use the represented native Word output.
omittedResponsibilities: Full content sections, header/footer content, non-decimal page numbering, page-grid and mirrored/gutter round trips remain open.

filenameDivergence.rationale: The section attribute output and its traversal bindings are split from the C++ exporter translation units.
